description: You are the Provincial M&E Coordinator. The quarterly Data Quality Review meeting is approaching, and you need to assess dataset reporting completeness. Using DHIS2 at http://localhost:8080 (login: admin / district): (1) Create a chart or table in the Data Visualizer app showing 'Reporting rates' (NOT data elements) for any health dataset (e.g., Child Health, Malaria, or similar) by District for the year 2023. (2) Save this visualization as a favorite named 'District Reporting Completeness 2023'. (3) Export the visualization data to /home/ga/Downloads/ as a CSV or Excel file. (4) Create a text file at /home/ga/Desktop/completeness_summary.txt listing any districts with reporting rates below 80% based on your analysis.
